resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register calls it the Selmer Lookout Tower; Tennessee Landforms and the March 2014 count use Bethel Springs. All three place it in McNairy County, and the record links the sources, but the match rests on county and name.

sources.title: Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers, 1933 to 1975 (National Register multiple property documentation form)

notes_for_editor: Name: the register says Selmer Lookout Tower; Landforms and the 2014 count say Bethel Springs (Landforms MNT005, state number 8-18). The record links them on county and name, which is reasonable but not proven. Elevation differs: 576 ft in the register, 570 ft in Landforms. The register entry has no build field, so no build date is given. The access level 'restricted' is an editorial reading of 'currently being used by the state'; a human should confirm. Two searches were used; the Selmer and Bethel Springs Wikipedia pages were checked and mention no tower. No new photos were found.
